title: Knotted Silky Slovakian Lamb Dumplings
description: Salty and silky Slovakian dish featuring lamb, this meal prep recipe is pescatarian friendly and made with brine wet ingredients. It is a hearty and comforting meal perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground lamb, flour, salt, and pepper, and mix until just combined.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg and water, then add to the lamb mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it is smooth and elastic.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a long rope.
Tie each rope into a knot and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bring the brine to a boil in a large pot, then reduce the heat to a simmer and add the dumplings.
Cook the dumplings for 10 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the brine with a slotted spoon and place on a plate.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top of the dumplings and serve hot.
